scientific_integrity: Closed-neighborhood asymmetric error-detecting identifying-code criterion, not the ordinary or redundant criterion. Two standalone exhaustive implementations with recorded outputs; independent external audit not conducted.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact census on the fixed 13-vertex Paley graph only; 78-element affine subgroup orbit census is explicit; not an all-orders result. Historical priority subject to unindexed literature.
title: Error-detecting identifying codes of the thirteen-vertex Paley graph
